section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential
title:
IRS TYPE DIFFERENTIAL
ON-VEHICLE REPLACEMENT OF SIDE GEAR SHAFT OIL SEAL

content.description: Exploded view diagram showing IRS differential assembly with carrier cover, side gear shaft, drive shaft, oil seal, snap ring, and gasket. Includes torque specifications for carrier cover bolts.

items: REMOVE SIDE GEAR SHAFT (See step 2 on page RA-23)
REMOVE SIDE GEAR SHAFT OIL SEAL (See step 3 on page RA-23)
INSTALL SIDE GEAR SHAFT OIL SEAL (See step 16 on page RA-35)
INSTALL SIDE GEAR SHAFT (See step 17 on page RA-36)
MEASURE SIDE GEAR SHAFT RUNOUT (See step 18 on page RA-36)
INSTALL CARRIER COVER (See step 19 on page RA-36)
CONNECT DRIVE SHAFT (See step 4 on page RA-38)
INSTALL DRAIN PLUG AND FILL DIFFERENTIAL WITH GEAR OIL

content.description: Illustration showing SST (Special Service Tool) being used to measure or install side gear shaft component
Cross-sectional diagram showing drain plug installation detail with directional arrows indicating proper orientation

content.text: Hypoid gear oil: w/LSD use LSD oil only
Capacity: 1.2 liters (1.3 US qts, 1.1 Imp. qts)
